_comment: Machine-readable constants for Chia. condition_opcodes maps NAME->hex, condition_opcodes_by_hex maps hex->NAME (for decoding spend conditions). last_updated: 2026-09-19.

rpc_urls._note: Coinset hosted full node RPCs. No authentication required. HTTP POST with JSON body.

max_tx_clvm_cost_note: Default per-bundle ceiling: MAX_BLOCK_COST_CLVM // 2. Configurable per-node.

node_cost_estimates._note: From full_node_rpc_api.py _get_spendbundle_type_cost (node's built-in stopgap estimates). CLVM cost units (not mojos). send_xch_transaction (9,401,710) is the node's 1-input/2-output estimate. The ~19 TPS derivation uses ~6M in-generator cost (compressed within a block) — ~6M in-generator cost is what makes the documented ~1,000 tx/block figure consistent with the 11e9 budget (1,000 × 6M = 6e9, fitting within MAX_BLOCK_COST_CLVM of 11e9). Use ~17M (standalone) for fee estimation of isolated spend bundles; the node estimate below is what the node uses internally for its cost-sampling bucket.

puzzle_mod_hashes._comment: Tree hashes of the uninstantiated (uncurried) puzzle modules. These are the template hashes — not coin puzzle hashes (which also incorporate curried arguments). Source: chia_puzzles_py.programs from chia-blockchain 2.7.4.
puzzle_mod_hashes.p2_delegated_puzzle_or_hidden_puzzle_not: Standard XCH transaction puzzle. Coins locked with 0x<public_key> curried in use this mod hash as their outer template. Most ordinary XCH wallets produce p2 coins.
puzzle_mod_hashes.cat_v2_note: CAT2 standard outer puzzle (Token and Asset Issuance Limiter). All CAT coins have this as their outer puzzle mod hash. Check the curried tail_hash for the specific asset ID.
puzzle_mod_hashes.singleton_top_layer_v1_1_note: Singleton outer layer (CHIP-0005 / CHIP-0004). All singletons (NFTs, DIDs, pool state) use this mod hash. The launcher ID is curried in.
puzzle_mod_hashes.nft_state_layer_note: NFT state layer (inner layer of NFT singletons, CHIP-0005). Holds metadata URIs, royalty info, and ownership transfer program.
puzzle_mod_hashes.settlement_payments_note: Offer settlement puzzle (the notarized payment mechanism). Offer-created coins are locked with this puzzle. Also called OFFER_MOD in chia-blockchain source.

_standard_xch_send_cost_note: 17M is the standalone single-bundle cost measured by chialisp.com (puzzle reveals fully serialized). 6M is the in-generator cost when puzzle reveals are compressed/deduplicated across a block. A full transaction block holds ~1,000 two-in/two-out sends (defined by docs.chia.net as 2,000 outputs), giving ~19 TPS at the ~52s mean tx-block interval. Use 17M only for fee estimation of isolated spend bundles. See node_cost_estimates._note for the relationship to the node internal 9.4M figure.
